title: Payton: Nix 'doing good,' on course for minicamp

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Payton: Nix 'doing good,' on course for minicamp
sources.description: Broncos coach Sean Payton said Saturday that quarterback Bo Nix is on track to participate on a limited basis in the team's minicamp next month and will be "full speed'' by the time the team's training camp begins this summer.
